LanguageData.Aftermath_Settings_BracedDoorsDesc: A player door destroyed by hostiles, or battered below 30% of its hit points, leaves a breach on its cell. The door rebuilt (or repaired) there shows one crossed plank per breach and lists their dates when inspected.
LanguageData.Aftermath_Settings_TrophyStandardsDesc: When the leader of a hostile humanlike raid is downed or killed, he drops his faction's standard. Install it anywhere: it shows the faction's colours, remembers the day and who brought him down, and gives pride to colonists who see it (more to those who fought that day).
LanguageData.Aftermath_Settings_HonoredFoesDesc: A raider who brings down two colonists, or kills one, is remembered. Bury him and his grave carries his own weapon, stood upright, with his helmet on top, and tells his name and deeds.
LanguageData.Aftermath_Settings_VigilLampsDesc: The bed of anyone fighting for their life glows a faint amber. When the danger passes the light fades; if they die it goes out at once.
LanguageData.Aftermath_Settings_BedsideOfferingsDesc: Each visit to a wounded colonist leaves a small gift by the bed: flowers from a lover, a letter from family, a carved figure from a friend, a candle from anyone else. Those who dislike the patient leave nothing. Back on their feet, the patient is cheered by how many came.
LanguageData.Aftermath_Settings_OldSentinelsDesc: A turret that brings down 5 foes over at least 3 separate battles is given a name by the colonists, and keeps a tally of the foes it brings down. Colonists who man it or fight beside it become its old hands. When a named turret is destroyed it leaves its named remains, and the colony mourns it (its old hands most of all). Uninstalled and reinstalled turrets keep their name.
